experimental_procedure: Dibarrelane-1-carboxylic Acid (9). To a solution of HgCl2 (330 mg, 1.22 mmol) in H2O (24 mL) was added Zn powder (12.0 g, 184 mmol), and the mixture was vigorously stirred for 1 h. The supernatant liquid was removed by decantation. To the residue were added concentrated HCl (60 mL), H2O (40 mL), and a solution of diketone 15 (559 mg, 2.02 mmol) in toluene (14 mL), and the twophase mixture was vigorously stirred and heated to reflux. Zn powder (9.0 g) was added portionwise until products converged on a single spot by TLC analysis. After it was cooled to room temperature, the mixture was diluted with Et2O/H2O and separated. The aqueous layer was extracted with CH2Cl2. The combined organic layers were washed with brine, dried over Na2SO4, filtered, and concentrated in vacuo.
